notes: All 14 source and 24 target IDs are partitioned exactly once.

The supplied with him* rides with σύμφυτοι: only him is italicized, with answering to the adjective's σύν- element, and no other token stands to license it since αὐτοῦ is spent on his. The ASV margin (Or, united with the likeness) attaches the dative differently but writes the same English words.

The two his are analysed differently on purpose: αὐτοῦ is expressed in the first clause and empties its article under rule 20, while the second clause has no possessor token, so its article takes the supplied his with the case preposition riding along under rule 21.

in the likeness in the second clause is added under rule 103, ὁμοιώματι being spent on t011 and all three words italicized; reading them as a discontinuous second realization of s005 and s006 under rule 15 remains defensible.
ἀλλά is unrepresented and καί takes also, the ASV writing no but; a reference comparison will report the empty ἀλλά as a disagreement.
